plan.reason: With only 24 of 100 evaluations used and stagnation of 18 with zero recent improvement, the search needs more exploration to escape a flat/plateaued region while staying within the modest budget. Auto surrogate hedges between RBF and quadratic early when data is sparse. current_to_best with slightly higher mutation and near-1 crossover balances convergence with diversity; exploration raised to 0.45 lets novelty break ties for under-sampled regions. local_fraction moderate at 0.25 avoids over-exploiting the stalled incumbent; radius 0.15 keeps local searches compact in normalized space. Population 32 and 6 generations keep per-cycle true evaluations reasonable so most budget remains for adaptation.
